2608.21099.title: A2DINOv3: Rethinking Multi-Modal Object Detection via Socialized Collaboration
2608.21099.paper_summary: Multi-modal object detection is essential for robust scene understanding in challenging conditions, including low-light and adverse environments. Recent vision foundation models (e.g., DINOv3) have exhibited strong representation capabilities, yet adapting them to multi-modal scenarios remains challenging. Existing dense cross-modal fusion strategies often force heterogeneous modalities to interact indiscriminately, which may introduce redundant information and disrupt the valuable pre-trained representations. To address this issue, we revisit multi-modal fusion from the perspective of socialized learning and propose adapter to DINOv3 (A2DINOv3), a multi-expert collaboration framework with a Socialized Collaboration Protocol (SCP). Specifically, RGB and infrared branches are modeled as heterogeneous experts that independently preserve their specialized knowledge while exchanging complementary information through selective and constrained interactions. This design mitigates harmful cross-modal interference and prevents degradation of pre-trained priors during adaptation. Furthermore, a zero-initialization strategy is introduced to gradually activate cross-modal collaboration, enabling a smooth transition from modality-specific learning to cooperative representation learning. Extensive experiments on four multi-modal benchmarks, including aerial detection (GAIIC), autonomous driving (FLIR), low-light surveillance (LLVIP), and diverse real-world scenarios (M3FD), demonstrate that A2DINOv3 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-modal object detection.
2608.21099.paper_summary_zh: 多模態物體檢測對於在挑戰性條件下（包括低光和不利環境）進行穩健的場景理解至關重要。最近的視覺基礎模型（例如，DINOv3）展現了強大的表徵能力，但將它們適應於多模態場景仍然具有挑戰性。現有的密集跨模態融合策略往往強迫異質模態無差別地互動，這可能引入冗餘信息並破壞有價值的預訓練表徵。為了解決這個問題，我們從社會化學習的角度重新審視多模態融合，並提出了DINOv3的適配器（A2DINOv3），這是一個具有社會化協作協議（SCP）的多專家協作框架。具體而言，RGB和紅外分支被建模為異質專家，獨立保留其專門知識，同時通過選擇性和受限的互動交換互補信息。這一設計減輕了有害的跨模態干擾，並防止在適應過程中預訓練先驗的退化。此外，還引入了一種零初始化策略，以逐步啟動跨模態協作，使得從特定模態學習到合作表徵學習的過渡變得平滑。在四個多模態基準上的廣泛實驗，包括空中檢測（GAIIC）、自動駕駛（FLIR）、低光監控（LLVIP）和多樣的現實世界場景（M3FD），證明了A2DINOv3在多模態物體檢測中始終達到最先進的性能。
